sky.qualification: Kerberos's sky orientation for its camera; the shared universe draws the visible sky.
sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

provenance.source: JPL Pluto-system ephemeris; Weaver et al. (2016) flyby rotation as an approximate display orientation. The 2025 shape fit has no converged pole solution.
provenance.qualification: Computed Kerberos Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
